post.description:
Creates a paused stage of the game's lesson (the app shows a 3-2-1 countdown, then resumes it). The words or
questions are chosen from the user's level, history and review list: there is nothing to configure.

Show the next hint of an open turn

A moving target reached the ground/base (Challenge)

Finish the stage and claim its reward once
End the session early (no completion reward)

get.summary: Result of a finished session, with every answer
The user's “cần ôn” list, weakest first, grouped by topic
Progress per word, grammar point and math problem type
Words met in the vocabulary games, most recent first, a page at a time
get.description:
`counts` are for the whole history (the filter tabs); `total` is the number of words matching the filter and
search, of which `items` is the page from `offset`.

get.summary: One word: meaning, pronunciation, examples, results per game and every answer

post.summary: Practise chosen words, or the “Cần ôn” words, in a vocabulary game
post.description:
A review stage of the chosen game (lesson "Tổng hợp"): progress, the review list and this history update as in
any stage; review stages earn no completion reward, so the reward rules are unchanged.

game.title: Game
game.description: word_shooter: Bắn từ tiếng Anh; meteor: Bắn thiên thạch Việt → Anh; gate: Chọn đáp án ngữ pháp; bridge: Sắp xếp câu. The content is picked by the backend from the user's progress.

start_paused.title: Start Paused
start_paused.description: Create it paused (the app counts down 3-2-1, then /resume).

status.title: Status
status.description: granted | capped | daily_cap_reached | daily_task | already_claimed | not_eligible | none

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Grammar: mixed (default), gate or bridge. Vocabulary: meteor (Việt → Anh, default) or word_shooter (Anh → Việt).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Device timezone; becomes the account timezone if none is set.

start_paused.title: Start Paused
start_paused.description: Create it paused (the app shows the session's lesson first; the clock starts with /resume).

client_event_id.title: Client Event Id
client_event_id.description: Idempotency key chosen by the app per action; a retry with the same id changes nothing.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: A re-practice turn after a revealed answer or a mistake in Học tập.

travel_seconds.title: Travel Seconds
travel_seconds.description: Challenge only: time for the target to reach the ground/base. 0 = waits.

on_screen_ms.title: On Screen Ms
on_screen_ms.description: Play time since the turn was issued, so a reopened game puts each target back where it was instead of at the top.

turn_id.title: Turn Id
turn_id.description: The turn this event resolved. A typed shot can hit another falling word than the one aimed at (the one closest to the ground whose answer matches).

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: Only once the turn is resolved or revealed.

word.description: Vocabulary: the English word and its Vietnamese meaning, once the turn is resolved or revealed.
